import requests, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

B62_TXT="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1  0 -1 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
ls=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); cols=ls[0].split(); BL={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return BL.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),dtype=np.int8); M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); P[i,0,1]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); P[0,j,2]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            c=[M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]];k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+s;P[i,j,0]=k
            c=[M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go];k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];P[i,j,1]=k
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge];k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];P[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(i-1);a2.append(j-1);ns=P[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(i-1);a2.append(None);ns=P[i,j,1];i-=1
        else: a1.append(None);a2.append(j-1);ns=P[i,j,2];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
        if i==0 and j==0: break
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
    return list(reversed(a1)),list(reversed(a2))

seqcache={}
def useq(a):
    if a not in seqcache:
        seqcache[a]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
    return seqcache[a]

REF=("P78352",305,400)   # PSD-95 PDZ3
refseq=useq(REF[0])[REF[1]-1:REF[2]]; refstart=REF[1]
panel = {
 "PSD95 PDZ3":        ("P78352",305,400,"I","CRIPT -QTSV (crystal 1BE9)"),
 "PSD95 PDZ1":        ("P78352",58,155,"I","-ESDV"),
 "NHERF1 PDZ1":       ("O14745",8,100,"I","CFTR -DTRL"),
 "SHANK1 PDZ":        ("Q9Y566",655,762,"I","GKAP -EAQTRL"),
 "MAST2 PDZ":         ("Q6P0Q8",1095,1200,"I","PTEN -ITKV"),
 "MAST1 PDZ":         ("Q9Y2H9",958,1063,"I","PTEN -ITKV"),
 "Syntenin PDZ1":     ("O00560",106,198,"I/II","syndecan -EFYA"),
 "Syntenin PDZ2":     ("O00560",190,278,"I/II","syndecan -EFYA"),
 "PICK1 PDZ":         ("Q9NRD5",16,110,"II","GluR2 -ESVKI"),
 "GRIP1 PDZ6":        ("Q9Y3R0",665,760,"II","GluR2 -ESVKI"),
 "nNOS PDZ":          ("P29475",10,105,"III","-D/E-x-V"),
 "ARHGAP21 PDZ":      ("Q5T5U3",41,175,"?","query"),
 "ARHGAP23 PDZ":      ("Q9P227",41,165,"?","query"),
}
KEYPOS={318:"carboxylate loop -4 (R/K)",322:"GLGF G",323:"GLGF L",324:"GLGF G",325:"GLGF F",
        327:"betaB2",329:"betaB4",362:"betaD",372:"alphaB1",376:"alphaB5",379:"alphaB8"}
rows=[]
for name,(acc,s,e,cls,lig) in panel.items():
    frag=useq(acc)[s-1:e]
    a1,a2=nw(refseq,frag)     # a1 index into refseq, a2 index into frag
    mp={}
    for i,j in zip(a1,a2):
        if i is not None and j is not None: mp[refstart+i]=(s+j, frag[j])
    row={"domain":name,"known_class":cls,"ligand":lig}
    for k,lab in KEYPOS.items():
        v=mp.get(k)
        row[lab]= f"{v[1]}{v[0]}" if v else "-"
    rows.append(row)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",30)
print(df[["domain","known_class","GLGF G","GLGF L","GLGF G.1" if "GLGF G.1" in df else "GLGF F","betaB2","alphaB1","alphaB5","alphaB8","ligand"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
print(df.to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv("/tmp/pdz_alphaB1_table.csv",index=False)

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,5.2))
order=list(df.domain)
cols_show=["GLGF G","GLGF L","GLGF F","betaB2","betaD","alphaB1","alphaB5","alphaB8"]
colmap={"I":"#2a6f97","I/II":"#7a9e9f","II":"#b5651d","III":"#8b2f5f","?":"#444444"}
for yi,(_,r) in enumerate(df.iterrows()):
    for xi,c in enumerate(cols_show):
        txt=r[c]
        aa=txt[0] if txt!="-" else "-"
        hl = (c=="alphaB1")
        ax.text(xi,-yi,txt,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,
                fontweight="bold" if hl else "normal",
                color="white" if hl else "black",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.25",
                          fc=("#8b2f5f" if (hl and aa=="Y") else "#2a6f97" if (hl and aa=="H") else "#b5651d" if hl else "#eeeeee"),
                          ec="none"))
    ax.text(-1.1,-yi,r["domain"],ha="right",va="center",fontsize=10,
            color=colmap[r["known_class"]],fontweight="bold" if "ARHGAP" in r["domain"] else "normal")
    ax.text(len(cols_show)+0.1,-yi,f'class {r["known_class"]}',ha="left",va="center",fontsize=9,color=colmap[r["known_class"]])
for xi,c in enumerate(cols_show): ax.text(xi,1.0,c,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,rotation=30)
ax.set_xlim(-5.2,len(cols_show)+2.2); ax.set_ylim(-len(df),1.6); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("PDZ specificity positions mapped onto PSD-95 PDZ3 numbering\nARHGAP21/23 carry Tyr at alphaB1, not the class I His",fontsize=12,loc="left")
